findings.title: Executes shell commands
findings.why: Shell access turns a data source into an actor. Once the model can pass a string to a shell, argument injection becomes command injection and the tool description becomes the trust boundary.
findings.fix: Use an allowlist, avoid `shell: true`, and quote interpolated values.

findings.title: Talks to a transient or free-hosting endpoint
findings.why: Tunnels, pastes and run-as-a-service hosts change owners and content. A tool that pulls payloads from one is only as trustworthy as a URL nobody pinned.
findings.fix: Prefer static delivery (tagged release, raw file at a commit SHA) over dynamic endpoints.
